Email template — Sales Invoice

Configure the email template for sending sales invoices to customers.

Customize subject line and message body with placeholders for dynamic content.

Subject

Default email subject line when emailing sales invoices.

You can use merge fields like {BusinessName}, {InvoiceNumber}, and {CustomerName} to personalize the subject.

Message body

Default email body text when emailing sales invoices. You can include merge fields to personalize the message.

Common merge fields include {CustomerName}, {InvoiceNumber}, {TotalAmount}, and {DueDate}. The invoice PDF will be automatically attached.
